metadata.description: A collection of useful Claude Code plugins for development workflows

plugins.name: kjgarza-base
plugins.description: Base MCP server configuration with puppeteer, fetch, sequential thinking, and context7 documentation servers

plugins.name: scholarly-comms-researcher
plugins.description: Expert agent for scholarly communication research with Dimensions database integration and academic search capabilities

plugins.name: senior-software-developer
plugins.description: Expert-level development assistance for architecture, code review, system design, and technical leadership

plugins.name: kjgarza-product
plugins.description: Product management toolkit with document processing, integrations, and research capabilities

plugins.name: bookclub
plugins.description: Book club management plugin for generating Slack communications, discussion materials, and reading schedules

plugins.name: rapid-mvp
plugins.description: Opinionated defaults and scaffolding for rapid MVP static websites using Next.js or 11ty monorepo patterns

plugins.name: berlin-events
plugins.description: Discover interesting art and food events in Berlin, check against your Google Calendar, and get a curated list with travel context from your neighborhood.

plugins.name: readitlater-digest
plugins.description: Generate themed weekly digests from Obsidian ReadItLater bookmarks with SQLite state tracking and automated cleanup

plugins.name: prototyping-skills
plugins.description: Skills for rapid prototype development with a standardized Bun monorepo stack (core, types, api, ui, mcp). Encodes conventions, deviation protocol, per-package patterns, test scaffolding, and development workflow chaining.

plugins.name: ideation
plugins.description: 5-stage ideation pipeline: problem intake, solution generation, review, ASCII UI concepts, and interactive HTML prototypes

plugins.name: finanz-pilot
plugins.description: German finance and accounting assistant for HGB bookkeeping, SKR04 account mapping, journal entries, financial statements, tax checks, and personal finance analysis.
